# Raster Processing: Monthly to Quarterly Aggregation

Monthly Black Marble nighttime light rasters are aggregated into calendar quarters (Q1–Q4). For each quarter, the three corresponding monthly rasters are combined using the pixel-wise mean, preserving the original radiance units while reducing short-term temporal variability.

- **Q1:** January–February–March

- **Q2:** April–May–June

- **Q3:** July–August–September

- **Q4:** October–November–December

```{r}
# folder for quarterly GeoTIFF rasters
quarter_tif_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "blackmarble_quarterly_tif")
dir.create(quarter_tif_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
all_files <- list.files(
  tif_dir,
  pattern = "\\.tif$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Extract metadata (year and month) from filenames
# Expected format: ntl_YYYY_MM.tif
get_info <- function(f) {
  
  x <- gsub("ntl_|\\.tif", "", basename(f))
  parts <- strsplit(x, "_")[[1]]
  
  data.frame(
    file = f,
    year = as.integer(parts[1]),
    month = as.integer(parts[2])
  )
}

# Build metadata table
meta <- bind_rows(lapply(all_files, get_info))
meta %>% mutate(file = basename(file))
```

```{r}
# Years to aggregate
target_years <- c(2012:2025)

# Filter to selected years only
meta <- meta %>%
  filter(year %in% target_years)

# Assign calendar quarters
meta$quarter <- case_when(
  meta$month %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ "Q1",
  meta$month %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ "Q2",
  meta$month %in% c(7, 8, 9)    ~ "Q3",
  meta$month %in% c(10, 11, 12) ~ "Q4"
)

# Unique year-quarter combinations
groups <- unique(meta[, c("year", "quarter")])
groups
```

```{r}
# Empty data frame to store NA statistics per quarter
na_stats <- data.frame()

# Loop over each year-quarter group
for (i in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
  
  current_year <- groups$year[i]
  current_quarter <- groups$quarter[i]
  
  cat("Processing:", current_year, current_quarter, "...\n")
  
  # Select files for current quarter
  files_group <- meta %>%
    filter(year == current_year, quarter == current_quarter) %>%
    arrange(month) %>%
    pull(file)
  
  # Skip incomplete quarters (must have 3 months)
  if (length(files_group) != 3) {
    cat("Skipping incomplete quarter:", current_year, current_quarter, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Read monthly rasters using native terra function
  r_list <- lapply(files_group, rast)
  
  # Create SpatRaster stack
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  
  # Compute quarterly mean (preserves radiance units)
  r_quarter <- app(r_stack, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Compute NA statistics
  na_pixels <- global(r_quarter, fun = function(x) sum(is.na(x)))[1,1]
  
  na_stats <- rbind(
    na_stats,
    data.frame(
      year = current_year,
      quarter = current_quarter,
      n_cells = ncell(r_quarter),
      na_pixels = na_pixels,
      valid_pixels = ncell(r_quarter) - na_pixels,
      na_percentage = 100 * na_pixels / ncell(r_quarter)
    )
  )
  
  # Define output file base name
  out_base_tif <- file.path(
    quarter_tif_dir,
    paste0("ntl_", current_year, "_", current_quarter)
  )
  
  # Export GeoTIFF
  writeRaster(
    r_quarter,
    paste0(out_base_tif, ".tif"),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
  
  cat("Saved:", current_year, current_quarter, "\n")
}
```

```{r}
# Final summary table
```

# Kampala

## ROI - Region Of Interest

```{r}
# Load ROI (administrative boundaries)
roi_sf <- readRDS("./data/gadm/gadm41_UGA_1_pk.rds")

# Extract Kampala region
kampala <- roi_sf[roi_sf$NAME_1 == "Kampala"]
str(kampala)
```

## Single-Month Raster Extraction for Kampala

```{r}
file_tif <- file.path(tif_dir, "ntl_2021_03.tif")
r <- rast(file_tif)

# log transform
r_log <- log1p(r)

# crop + mask 
r_kampala <- terra::mask(
  terra::crop(r_log, kampala),
  kampala
)
```

```{r}
terra::crs(kampala)
```

```{r}
kampala_ext <- terra::ext(kampala)
# kampala_ext <- terra::extend(kampala_ext, 0)  # padding (in degrees)

r_kampala_square <- terra::crop(r_log, kampala_ext)
```

## Local Spatial Imputation of Missing Pixels

```{r}
# Count the total number of missing values (NAs) within the rectangular bounding box of the Kampala buffered area
terra::global(is.na(r_kampala_square), "sum")
```

This step performs a **local spatial imputation of missing pixels** in the Kampala nighttime lights raster.

Missing values (NA) are replaced using a **3×3 moving window mean**, implemented through a focal filter. The 3×3 window includes the target pixel and its eight immediate neighbors (adjacent and diagonal cells). This local neighborhood is used to compute a mean value, providing an estimate of the missing observation based on surrounding spatial context.

Importantly, only missing pixels are imputed, while all observed values remain unchanged. This ensures that the original radiance signal is preserved and that no additional smoothing is introduced into valid data points.

The 3×3 neighborhood represents a first-order spatial dependency structure, capturing fine-scale spatial continuity in nighttime light intensity. This is particularly appropriate for urban environments such as Kampala, where spatial variation occurs at small scales.

```{r}
# Compute local 3x3 neighborhood mean for each pixel
# This uses a moving window (focal operation) to estimate local values
r_local_mean <- terra::focal(
  r_kampala_square,
  w = matrix(1, 3, 3),   # 3x3 moving window
  fun = mean,            # local average
  na.rm = TRUE,          # ignore internal NAs when calculating the mean
  expand = TRUE          # clone edge pixels outwardly to prevent edge NA formation
)

# Replace ONLY missing values (NA) with local mean estimates
# Original observed values are preserved unchanged
r_filled <- terra::ifel(
  is.na(r_kampala_square),
  r_local_mean,
  r_kampala_square
)

# Check remaining number of missing values after imputation
terra::global(is.na(r_filled), "sum")
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(r_kampala_square, main = "Original Kampala Nighttime Lights",
     cex.main = 0.9)
plot(kampala, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)

plot(r_filled, main = "Nighttime Lights after Local NA Imputation",
     cex.main = 0.9)
plot(kampala, add = TRUE, border = "blue", lwd = 2)
```

# Spatial Consistency Check and Missing Data Analysis on Fixed Kampala Bounding Box

```{r}
na_kampala_stats <- data.frame()

for (f in list.files(quarter_tif_dir, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.tif$")) {
  
  # Read raster
  r <- rast(f)
  
  # Log transform
  r_log <- log1p(r)
  
  # Fixed Kampala bounding box (SQUARE GRID)
  kampala_ext <- terra::ext(kampala)
  r_kampala_square <- terra::crop(r_log, kampala_ext)
  
  # NA count on square grid
  na_count <- terra::global(is.na(r_kampala_square), "sum")[1,1]
  
  # Store results
  na_kampala_stats <- rbind(
    na_kampala_stats,
    data.frame(
      file = basename(f),
      na_pixels = na_count,
      n_cells = terra::ncell(r_kampala_square),
      na_percentage = 100 * na_count / terra::ncell(r_kampala_square)
    )
  )
}

na_kampala_stats
```

# Kampala Quarterly Raster Processing

```{r}
# Folder to store Kampala-processed rasters
kampala_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "kampala")
dir.create(kampala_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# List all quarterly raster files 
quarter_files <- list.files(
  quarter_tif_dir,
  pattern = "\\.tif$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
kampala_files <- list()

for (f in quarter_files) {
  
  cat("Processing:", basename(f), "\n")
  
  # Read raster
  r <- rast(f)
  
  # Log transform
  r_log <- log1p(r)
  
  # Fixed Kampala bounding box (SQUARE GRID)
  kampala_ext <- terra::ext(kampala)
  r_kampala_square <- terra::crop(r_log, kampala_ext)
  
  # NA check BEFORE imputation
  na_before <- terra::global(is.na(r_kampala_square), "sum")[1,1]
  
  # Impute ONLY if NA exist
  if (na_before > 0) {
    
    r_local_mean <- terra::focal(
      r_kampala_square,
      w = matrix(1, 3, 3),
      fun = mean,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      expand = TRUE
    )
    
    r_kampala_square <- terra::ifel(
      is.na(r_kampala_square),
      r_local_mean,
      r_kampala_square
    )
  }
  
  # NA check AFTER imputation
  na_after <- terra::global(is.na(r_kampala_square), "sum")[1,1]
  
  # Output name
  out_name <- gsub("\\.tif", "", basename(f))
  
  out_file <- file.path(
    kampala_dir,
    paste0(out_name, "_kampala.tif")
  )
  
  writeRaster(r_kampala_square, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  kampala_files[[f]] <- out_file
  
  cat(
    "Saved:", basename(out_file),
    "| NA before:", na_before,
    "| NA after:", na_after,
    "\n"
  )
}
```

# Kampala Regional Base Map Visualization

```{r}
# Convert the 'kampala' SpatVector object into an sf object compatible with ggplot
kampala_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(kampala)

# Creation of the realistic Kampala map without visible lines
ggplot() +
  # 1. Realistic background (OpenStreetMap tiles)
  annotation_map_tile(type = "osm", zoom = 12, progress = "none") +
  
  # 2. Invisible layer to define geographic boundaries without drawing blue lines
  geom_sf(data = kampala_sf, fill = NA, color = NA) +
  
  # 3. Aesthetic settings and titles
  labs(
    title = "Kampala Region - Base Map",
    subtitle = "Real-world background via OpenStreetMap tiles",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", size = 10)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 11

# 1. Realistic base map on the left side
p1 <- ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(type = "osm", zoom = 12, progress = "none") +
  geom_sf(data = kampala_sf, fill = NA, color = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Kampala Region - Base Map",
    subtitle = "Real-world background via OpenStreetMap tiles",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", size = 10)
  )

# 2. Full grid with ALL pixels numbered from 1 to N
r_all_cells <- r_kampala_square
values(r_all_cells) <- 1:ncell(r_all_cells)

# Convert to dataframe removing NA cells so they don't print anything
df_all <- as.data.frame(r_all_cells, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(df_all)[3] <- "pixel_id"

p2 <- ggplot() +
  # Print only the text labels on a clean white background, omitting missing pixels
  geom_text(data = df_all, aes(x = x, y = y, label = pixel_id), color = "red", size = 2) +
  geom_sf(data = kampala_sf, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  # coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Full Pixel Grid",
    subtitle = "Active raster cells explicitly numbered",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# Combine both plots side by side
p_combined <- p1 + p2 + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1))

print(p_combined)
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plots_output_folder, "Kampala_Raster_Pixel_Index_Map.png"),
  plot = p_combined, 
  width = 18,
  height = 11,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
# 1. Create a copy of the original raster for inspection
r_check_values <- r_kampala_square

# 2. Convert the raster into a data frame (retaining x, y coordinates and the nightlight value)
df_values_check <- as.data.frame(r_check_values, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)

# 3. Assign the correct name to the value column (raster layer value or "nightlight")
colnames(df_values_check)[3] <- "nightlight_value"

# 4. Add a column with the numerical pixel ID (from 1 to N, row by row)
df_values_check$pixel_id <- 1:nrow(df_values_check)

# Reorder the columns for convenience (pixel_id, x, y, nightlight_value)
df_values_check <- df_values_check[, c("pixel_id", "x", "y", "nightlight_value")]

# Print the first 10 pixels (top-left corner) with their respective light values
cat("First 10 pixels (Top-Left):\n")
print(head(df_values_check, 10))
cat("\n")

# Print the last 10 pixels (bottom-right corner) with their respective light values
cat("Last 10 pixels (Bottom-Right):\n")
print(tail(df_values_check, 10))
```
